description: This Java class 'ImageResizer' provides functionality to resize images, maintaining aspect ratio, and outputting resized images as InputStreams. It handles different image formats and logs warnings on failure.

classes.name: ImageResizer
classes.description: A service class that provides image resizing functionality, adjusting image dimensions while maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes a given FileData object to specified maximum width and height, returning the resized image or original if resizing is not needed or fails.

methods.name: resizeImage
methods.description: Performs the actual image resizing operation, scaling the image to fit within maxWidth and maxHeight while maintaining aspect ratio.
